title: 5 Considerations for More Responsible AI | w/ Ashleigh Faith - IsA DataThing
description:
Check out Ashleigh Faith, Director of Knowledge Graph & Semantic Search for EBSCO Information, in her talk "5 tips for working toward more responsible AI". 

This is part 2 of a two part series done as a collaboration between Ashleigh and George Anadiotis, from Connected Data London / Linked Data Orchestration / ZDNet / Year of the Graph

In part 1 George and Ashleigh focus on IoT models in ML: https://youtu.be/eAf3j98XVkQ​ 

The series is in the context of Ashleigh Faith's and Paco Nathan's Master Classes at Connected Data London 2021 | tickets 👉 https://bit.ly/CDLApril21tix

Check out her YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZsTDApBUUdUpg024K33YNA
